# Overseas Income Tax

> Agent-neutral, review-first helper for China-resident overseas interest and ordinary cash dividend filing preparation.

Repository: https://github.com/DV-dvd/overseas-income-tax
Documentation: docs/agent-integration.md
Request example: examples/calculation-request.json

Interfaces:
- Python: overseas_income_tax.calculate
- CLI: overseas-income-tax calculate --input request.json
- HTTP: POST /api/v1/calculate
- Capabilities: GET /api/v1/capabilities
- JSON Schema: GET /api/v1/schema/calculation-request

Constraints:
- No model is used for tax calculation.
- Calculation does not require network access.
- Client-supplied rule snapshots are ignored.
- Human confirmation is required before an event can enter calculation.
- Automatic calculation scope is limited to verified interest and verified ordinary cash dividends.
- Capital gains, complex products, uncertain residency/source, prior-year, prepayment, and correction cases require review.
- "Unsupported" never means "not reportable".
